recent_videos.thesis: AI has shifted from a product cycle to one of the largest capital-formation cycles in history — splitting the market into capex-receivers (compute, energy, memory) and capex-spenders (the labs) — even as Broadcom's miss, a wave of trillion-dollar IPOs, and the Fed's still-absent productivity data show the boom is racing ahead of proof.

recent_videos.title: Thomas Laffont: The $4T AI IPO Wave Is Coming… and We've Never Seen Anything Like It
recent_videos.thesis: Coatue's Thomas Laffont argues the unicorn economy is healthier than in 2021 because AI has concentrated funding into a handful of real, fast-compounding 'Magnificent Eight' private companies whose imminent IPOs (SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI) will finally rebalance the ecosystem's cash-in versus cash-out.

recent_videos.title: SpaceX To Target $75B in IPO at $135 Per Share | Bloomberg Tech 6/03/2026

recent_videos.title: Alphabet To Raise $80B in Equity, Anthropic Files For IPO | Bloomberg Tech 6/2/2026
